subject: Commitment disbursement playbook + VAT / escrow instructions
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jane Sullivan <j.sullivan@acme-corp.com>, Accounts Payable <accounts-payable@acme-corp.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 09:21:00 +0000
Subject: Commitment disbursement playbook + VAT / escrow instructions

Hi team / Acme,

Following our call this morning, Acme is ready to move forward with the annual committed prepayment (EUR 1,200,000). We need a clear, single-sheet playbook that ops, AP, and our legal teams can follow: invoice cadence, PO triggers for drawdowns, VAT handling for intra-EU supply, and the escrow option they asked about.

Action items I propose: 
- Marcus: produce a drawdown matrix showing trigger events, ledger posting, and sample invoice lines. Include tax treatment notes for Germany/Netherlands.
- Monica: prepare the invoice schedule (dates, amounts, invoice references) and the standard wire instructions PDF.
- Priya: coordinate with Acme A/P for PO & required legal references, and capture whether escrow is required or if a straight prepay works.

Attached: RI_invoicing_schedule_Q2-2027.pdf (draft).

Jane / Liam — can you confirm the following by EOD Friday?
1) Legal prefers escrow or straight prepayment?
2) Do you require a single master PO or multiple POs per milestone?
3) Any specific VAT registration we should route invoices to?

Thanks,

Priya Natarajan
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.ai

---
Attachment: RI_invoicing_schedule_Q2-2027.pdf (1 page, draft)

From: Jane Sullivan <j.sullivan@acme-corp.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Accounts Payable <accounts-payable@acme-corp.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme-corp.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 08:43:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Commitment disbursement playbook + VAT / escrow instructions

Hi Priya / team,

Thanks for the summary. Quick answers from our side: 
1) Legal is leaning toward straight prepayment into our restricted account (no escrow) unless Redwood requires escrow for regulatory reasons.
2) We prefer a single master PO (PO-ACME-2027-089) and separate invoice references per drawdown.
3) VAT: route invoices to Acme EU VAT entity (VAT ID: EU123456789); invoices must show VAT ID and reverse charge box where applicable.

We can sign the DocuSign once we have a final invoice schedule and wire instructions.

Jane
VP, Procurement
Acme Corporation
j.sullivan@acme-corp.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>

Cc: Jane Sullivan <j.sullivan@acme-corp.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 14:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Commitment disbursement playbook + VAT / escrow instructions

Folks,

Attached is the drawdown_matrix_v1.xlsx with a proposed 6-drawdown cadence tied to usage thresholds and calendar dates. Key notes:
- Drawdown 1 (30%): on contract signature + bank transfer receipt verification.
- Drawdown 2-5 (10% each): either monthly or usage-triggered (we can toggle); prefer calendar triggers for simplicity.
- Final drawdown (10%): reserved for overage reconciliation and SLA credits.

Tax handling (summary):
- Invoices issued net of VAT to Acme EU VAT entity. We will include "reverse charge" language for supplies where applicable in EU jurisdiction. If Acme requires us to charge VAT, we will need to register in-country or adjust invoice flow.

Escrow note: setting up escrow adds ~2-3 weeks to onboarding and requires a separate escrow agreement and bank account setup. If Acme OKs straight prepay, we will provide a restricted account routing that meets finance control requirements.

I've attached the drawdown matrix and a sample invoice layout.

Marcus Lin
Head of Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

Hi Jane / team,

Updated invoice schedule attached and bank routing doc. Changes from draft: 
- We set calendar-based drawdowns on the 1st of each month (Jun-Nov) after initial 30% at signature.
- Invoices will include PO-ACME-2027-089 in the header and a tax summary line referencing Acme's VAT ID.
- Redwood provides a "restricted account" acknowledgement letter (included in the wire PDF).

Please confirm if the monthly cadence is acceptable or whether you prefer usage triggers instead. Once confirmed, we'll generate the final invoice set and route DocuSign.

Thanks,

Monica Patel

3) Monica to mark first invoice as "Due on receipt" and send to accounts-payable@acme-corp.com.
